# Recorded source responses

Trimmed responses recorded during spikes S1-S4 on 2026-10-03 (see docs/spikes/).
Only sources whose metadata may be redistributed are included: Crossref (abstracts and
reference lists removed), doi.org, DataCite, arXiv metadata, dblp (CC0) and OpenAlex (CC0).
Semantic Scholar responses are never stored here (license); its tests use synthetic data.
